## Policy Summary

- Intent: The goal of this project is to consolidate event publication, registration, and management through the creation of a REST API to ESTG / IPLeiria.
- Languages/Frameworks: golang, swag for API documentation, postgresql, docker
- Testing: Unit tests for each endpoint created, covering happy path and error cases. Minimum testing coverage percentage is 70%. We will use the built-in testing package of golang.
- Quality Gates: golangci-lint
- Review Policy: No approvals required for pull requests. The main branch is feature/sdd-plus-project1.
- Performance Targets: Default performance targets.
- Deployment Constraints: The application will be deployed via Docker.
